messages:
claire: quick heads-up — Vicario week0 private/VPC onboarding. customer hit a hard blocker when their model-serving pods can't fetch secrets; audit logs show repeated KMS permission denied. can we sync?
alyssa: flagged renewal risk if this drags >48h — they're in PO review next week. low tolerance for unplanned downtime.
mohit: seeing the KMS DENY in our telemetry (errors/2026-03-10T14:02Z). likely IAM binding missing for the node pool SA. will check auth graph.
ryan: network check: their egress SG only allows 443 to build-anchors. they need outbound to kms.redwood-internal.example:443 and tcp/6514 to our audit collector; requested infra change, awaiting approval.
jaya: runbook step 4 requires `kms:Decrypt` on node SA and `kms:Encrypt` on cache SA. did their terraform override the node_service_account?
claire: they overrode to a tenant-managed SA via their terraform. alyssa, can you confirm who made that change?
alyssa: sonal@vicario (customer infra lead) did. looping her in. @sonal please confirm SA email. :point_down:
deploy-bot: deploy event: private-deploy/vicario/installer v1.2.3 applied at 2026-03-10T13:50Z (ok).
mohit: mitigation option: short-lived grant of `roles/redwood.kmsUser` on the node pool with 24h TTL. reduces time to recover while we fix proper bindings. any objections?
claire: security-bot flagged their KMS policy earlier for a wildcard principal — must not grant temporary access until we ensure least-priv.
security-bot: alert: KMS key policy contains broad binding at 2026-03-09T22:14Z. recommended action: replace `principal: "*"` with service-account-specific binding. severity: medium.
mohit: alternative I can prototype: create a scoped wrapper key in our account and issue a one-time signed token for decrypt; lower blast radius. i'll draft in 3h.
ryan: firewall snippet (TF) I'll push for audit + kms egress in 2h. sample: ```tf resource "google_compute_firewall" "allow_audit_collector" { name = "allow-audit-collector" network = var.network allow { protocol = "tcp" ports = ["6514"] } destination_ranges = ["34.210.0.0/20"] direction = "EGRESS" priority = 1000 } ```
jaya: i'll update the runbook: explicitly map installer SA → node SA, add audit sink checklist (`logSink.vpcFlow` enablement), and troubleshooting commands: `kubectl describe pod`, `kubectl get secret`, `gcloud kms keys list`, and a sample `curl` to the collector.
alyssa: Sonal (DM) confirmed SA: `vicario-central-sa@vicario-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. posting for visibility.
claire: security-bot, please run automated policy scan against that SA and the customer KMS key.
security-bot: policy-scan queued. results expected in ~15m.
claire: action items: 1) Alyssa — confirm SA owner/contact and keep on the hook for infra PR (owner: alyssa) 2) Mohit — prototype short-lived key wrapper + TTL grant plan and post commands (owner: mohit) 3) Ryan — firewall TF snippet and dest ranges for audit collector & KMS egress (owner: ryan) 4) Jaya — update runbook with explicit SA mapping, audit sink checklist, and troubleshooting steps (owner: jaya) 5) Security — validate KMS policy and propose least-priv binding; block wildcard principals (owner: security-bot) 6) Claire — draft renewal-risk escalation note to sending list if not cleared in 48h (owner: claire).
claire: customer feedback note — Sonal said onboarding pace felt slower than expected and asked for clearer preflight checks; capture in post-onboard survey.
mohit: ETA for prototype & temp grant: 3h, will post exact commands and expiry flow.
ryan: ETA firewall PR: 2h, will include 443 and 6514.
claire: thanks all — please update this thread as progress happens. :white_check_mark:
